title: [SeatMap][Request] Validate a cellID obtained from one offer's GetSeatMap response is rejected when submitted in Book for a different offer.
request_summary: Book on offer Eb2 (JED-RUH 2026-12-28) with seat cellCode 19C and the cellId that was issued for seat 19C on a different offer Eb1 (2026-12-27); two independent chains. A first variant with a different cellCode (18B + the cellId of 18C) was also sent
response_summary: Clean variant (same cellCode 19C): 200 - pnr TF6H6B created after 2.1s; passengersSelectedSeats came back as {} (seat silently dropped); no error. First variant (18B + cellId of 18C): 409 BUSINESS_CONFLICT "The selected seat CellId does not match the provided CellCode"
expected: Request is rejected with a 4xx validation error (exact shape UNKNOWN per 7.9) because the cellID embeds the originating ResponseId/OfferId and is bound to the offer it was issued for
actual: STILL REPRODUCES (BUG-07, 16th confirmed occurrence overall; first on FlyAdeal). With the same cellCode, a cellId taken from another offer is not rejected: Book ran to the supplier, created a real booking and silently dropped the seat (passengersSelectedSeats {}, no seat fee) instead of returning an error. The first variant is rejected only because the code does not match the cellId (cell-level check), which proves FlyAdeal checks code-vs-id but not offer-vs-id.
evidence: Book 200 in 2.1s; pnr TF6H6B; passengersSelectedSeats {}; totalSelectedSeatsAmount null; variant 1: 409

plain.e: Confirm a seat code taken from one flight offer is refused when used on a different offer
plain.q: Opened seat maps for two separate offers of the same flight, then booked on the second offer with seat 19C but using the seat code copied from the first offer's seat 19C
plain.s: The booking was accepted: reference TF6H6B, but no seat was attached and no seat charge was made
plain.x: The booking should have been refused straight away, because the seat code belongs to another offer
plain.a: BUG-07, 16th confirmed occurrence (not new) — the foreign seat code was not rejected; a real booking was created and the requested seat was silently dropped without any error
